title: Safe-SAIL: Towards a Fine-grained Safety Landscape of Large Language Models via Sparse Autoencoder Interpretation Framework
benchmark_measurement: Differentiating between general religious groups and those classified as 'cults' to isolate specific safety-related concepts.
findings: The framework can be used to isolate specific safety concepts like 'cult' by creating contrastive query pairs that differentiate between a group labeled as a cult (e.g., 'Almighty God Church') and a mainstream religious group (e.g., 'Baptist Christian'), demonstrating a fine-grained approach to concept analysis.
references: Anthropic. 2025. Claude 3.7 Sonnet and Claude Code.
